title: Maximum separation distance
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the maximum separation must be 44 m.

title: Collision time
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the total time until collision must be 15 s.

title: Equal velocities time
description: Important: Correctly calculates the time (t1 = 3 s) when the velocities of car A and car B become equal.

title: Displacement calculations
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematics equations to find displacements of both cars during key intervals (e.g., x_B1, x_A1, x_B, x_A).

title: Interpretation of v-t graph
description: Important: Correctly extracts initial velocities (v_A = 4 m/s, v_B = 10 m/s) and deceleration of car B (a = 2 m/s²) from the provided diagram.

title: Collision condition logic
description: Important: Recognizes that collision occurs when car A's displacement equals car B's displacement plus the initial 35 m gap, and correctly structures the two-stage calculation (before and after car B stops).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, m/s²) throughout all calculations.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses a positive value for car B's acceleration instead of the correct negative deceleration in equations.

title: Misidentifying maximum separation
description: Pitfall: Assumes maximum separation occurs when car B stops, rather than when the velocities are equal.
